### NAME

`mcp-scan` - mcp-scan — Invariant's scanner: detects tool poisoning, prompt injection and tool-description drift in installed MCP servers.

### SYNOPSIS & usage

*Derived from the upstream README at generation
time; verify against `--help` where the tool is
installed.*

```
   export SNYK_TOKEN=your-api-token-here
```

```
# Scan the whole machine
uvx snyk-agent-scan@0.5.17

# Scan a specific MCP configuration
uvx snyk-agent-scan@0.5.17 ~/.vscode/mcp.json

# Scan a single agent skill
uvx snyk-agent-scan@0.5.17 ~/path/to/my/SKILL.md

# Scan all Claude skills
uvx snyk-agent-scan@0.5.17 ~/.claude/skills
```

### DESCRIPTION (upstream)

Snyk Agent Scan Discover and scan agent components on your machine for prompt injections<br/> and vulnerabilities (including agents, MCP servers, skills). > **Note:** We don't publish an npm package for Agent Scan.
